summary_en: Year-end dividend for the fiscal year ending December 2026 raised by 10 yen to 50 yen per share. Annual dividend forecast increased from 80 yen to 90 yen, reflecting strong semiconductor-related capital expenditure demand and upward revision of full-year earnings.
title_en: Notice regarding revision of full-year consolidated business forecast and revision of year-end dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief:
CONVUM Ltd. has revised upward its year-end dividend for the fiscal year ending December 2026. The year-end dividend per share has been increased by 10 yen to 50 yen, raising the annual dividend forecast from 80 yen to 90 yen per share. This follows an upward revision of the company's full-year consolidated business forecast, driven by strong demand from semiconductor-related capital expenditures.

The third quarter cumulative period showed favorable trends in orders and revenue, with operating profit up 46.0% and ordinary profit up 44.1% from the previously announced forecast. Based on current orders and momentum, the company revised its full-year earnings upward.

The dividend increase is consistent with the company's dividend policy of targeting a payout ratio of approximately 40% while balancing growth investments and financial soundness. The company views long-term profit distribution to shareholders as a key management priority, and this increase aims to further enhance shareholder returns on the basis of the improved earnings outlook.
